components.name: Hero Code Card
components.description: The harness of a project in two files: its Cargo.toml from the front matter of the landing page, and its main.rs read from a compiled example crate, with the command that runs it in a dark strip.
components.css: .ds-code-card { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d3d7dd); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--bg-soft, #f6f7f8); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); color: var(--text, #1d2025); } .ds-code-card code { font-family: var(--mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-ligatures: none; } .ds-code-card-file { padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider, #e3e6ea); color: var(--text-2, #565d67); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-code-card-pre { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-code-card-pre + .ds-code-card-file { border-top: 1px solid var(--divider, #e3e6ea); } .ds-code-card-pre code { display: block; width: max-content; min-width: 100%; padding: 1.125rem 1.25rem 1.25rem; } .ds-k { color: var(--code-keyword, #24508a); } .ds-e { color: var(--code-entity, #5b3f8f); } .ds-code-card-run { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto; background: var(--terminal, #1d2025); color: var(--terminal-text, #e7e8ea); font-size: 0.8125rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-code-card-prompt { color: #f2773d; font-family: var(--mono, ui-monospace, monospace); user-select: none; }

components.name: Code Panel

components.css: .ds-pre { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.5rem); background: var(--bg-soft, #f6f7f8); color: var(--text, #1d2025); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.7; tab-size: 4; } .ds-pre code { display: block; width: max-content; min-width: 100%; padding: 1rem 1.25rem 1.125rem; font-family: var(--mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-ligatures: none; } .ds-pre code::before { position: sticky; left: 0; display: block; width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 0.625rem; color: var(--text-3, #676e78); font-family: var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; content: attr(data-lang); } .ds-k { color: var(--code-keyword, #24508a); } .ds-s { color: var(--code-string, #2d6a3c); }

components.html: Run the action with --fix to change the files, or read the guide first.
components.css: .ds-prose { max-width: 37rem; margin: 0; color: var(--text, #1d2025); font-family: var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-prose a { color: var(--brand-text, #b13c0b); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-text, #b13c0b) 35%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 0.2em; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-prose a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-prose a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-prose code { padding: 0.15em 0.4em; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--bg-mute, #eceef1); font-family: var(--mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.875em; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The site of Rakko is the documentation site of a developer tool, with no twist. It holds the craft level of mise.jdx.dev: a sticky top bar, a landing page with a hero and a code sample, and documentation pages with a sidebar, a readable column, and an outline. A Rust developer recognizes every part on sight, so the attention goes to the code and the text. One system runs through the landing page and every documentation page.

The ground is white (near-black in dark mode), the text near-black, and secondary text a cool slate. Rakko orange is the only color with a voice. It marks the name, the primary button, links, the current page, and focus. Faces are the system UI face and the system monospace, with no web fonts. Code sits in soft gray panels with 8px corners; cards have 12px corners; 1px dividers separate sections. Depth is nearly flat: one soft shadow, under the code card of the hero.

The site has no JavaScript. Every responsive change is plain CSS, and the only motion is a 150 ms ease-out on the color and border of links and buttons. This design replaced a "service manual" design whose landing page was too dense and did not show that Rakko is a developer tool.
keyCharacteristics: The first view proves the tool with code: the harness that a project writes, and the command that runs it.
Orange is the brand color, and it is reserved for the name, the primary action, links, the current page, and focus.
System faces only: system UI for text, system monospace for code.
Soft code panels, 1px dividers, 8px and 12px corners, and one shadow.
Light and dark mode from the same tokens, chosen by the system setting.
No JavaScript; the layout adapts at 75rem, 60rem, and 40rem.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the name, the primary action, links, the current page, and focus, and nothing else. It never decorates a rule, a border at rest, or a heading.

rules.name: The Text Orange Rule
rules.body: Small text in orange uses `brand-text`, never `brand`; `brand` is for fills, outlines, and borders.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: The site loads no font. Text uses the system UI face and code the system monospace.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose holds a measure of 37rem. Code panels and tables may run to the 43rem column.

rules.name: The Whole Flag Rule
rules.body: Inline code never wraps, so a flag such as `--fix` or a path stays whole on one line.

rules.name: The No-Script Rule
rules.body: Every responsive change is CSS. Navigation that needs a toggle becomes a link to a place on the page.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the code card of the hero casts a shadow. Every other surface is flat.

dos: Do keep orange to the name, the primary action, links, the current page, and focus.
Do use `brand-text` for orange text and `brand` for fills and outlines.
Do keep prose at the 37rem measure, and let code and tables run to 43rem.
Do keep inline code on one line, and keep the indentation of code in panels with a sideways scroll.
Do show real code from a compiled example crate wherever a page shows the API.
Do separate sections with 1px dividers and soft panels, not shadows.
Do define every color as a token on `:root` with a partner in the dark mode block.
Do limit motion to 150 ms ease-out on color and border, and drop it for reduced motion.
donts: Don't load a web font; use the system UI face and the system monospace.
Don't add JavaScript; responsive navigation uses links to places on the page.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.
Don't add a shadow to any surface other than the code card of the hero.
Don't use orange for decorative rules or borders at rest.
Don't make the landing page dense or editorial; it is a developer tool landing page with a hero, a code sample, and short bands.
Don't draw or imitate the Aonyx logo; use the supplied file.
